source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Construction problems use only a compass and an unmarked straightedge: lines with the straightedge, circles with the compass.
stages.headlineEnglish: Construction problems use only a compass and an unmarked straightedge: lines with the straightedge, circles with the compass.

stages.headline: To lay off a segment equal to AB on a ray, open the compass to AB and draw an arc from the ray's start.
stages.headlineEnglish: To lay off a segment equal to AB on a ray, open the compass to AB and draw an arc from the ray's start.

stages.headline: To copy an angle, draw arcs with the same radius from both vertices, then transfer the distance between the arc's crossing points with the compass.
stages.headlineEnglish: To copy an angle, draw arcs with the same radius from both vertices, then transfer the distance between the arc's crossing points with the compass.

stages.headline: Which tools are allowed in construction problems?
stages.headlineEnglish: Which tools are allowed in construction problems?

choices: a marked ruler and a protractor
a compass and an unmarked ruler

stages.problemText: How do you construct a segment twice AB?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. Lay off AB twice along a ray.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. Lay off AB twice along a ray.
